hero.title: File:Ht camp keating 100205 mn.jpg
hero.description:
Chinook helicopter above Combat Outpost Keating, Nuristan, Afghanistan
Original caption:

" A Chinook helicopter lands at Combat Outpost Keating, Afghanistan, in this March 2007, file photo. A military investigation of a Taliban attack last fall on the remote U.S. army outpost that left eight American soldiers dead and 22 wounded has resulted in administrative punishments for two commanders blamed for "inadequate measures taken by the chain of command."
(Sgt. Amber Robinson/U.S. Army)
categories: Military helicopters in the War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)
